records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Harbor Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account created a first project on day 2 (2026-07-15) showing some initiative, but no invites sent, zero replies to two outreach emails (email:caf918d3, email:3d4e3113), no tickets, and Starter plan solo use. Silent, single-user accounts with 8 days left rarely reach key_milestone unaided.

draft.subject: Next step after your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the work your team is actually tracking this week is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week and walk through your setup with you — just reply with a time that works and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Priya
